name: Project Pixel CG Style Profile v1
canonical_note: Chosen from the five previously accepted CGs because it has the lowest flat_ratio and highest edge density among the currently approved set. It becomes the single style target; the other four are legacy accepted but are not additional standards.
normalization: RGB, resized to width 960 with Lanczos before measuring
pass_rule: All five metrics must be inside the bands. Additionally, no uniform checkerboard dithering and no smooth anime rendering.
